title: fix(scripts): ablation-replace WRAP restores on SIGTERM while the wrapped command waits

Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (`git grep ablation-replace -- skills content/docs`: 0 hits, exit 1; the only doc mention is `packages/qa/dogfood/README.md`, which names the tool and needs no change)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:消融工具 `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` 的包裹模式改为异步启动子命令;子命令运行期间收到 SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP 时,先把信号转发给子命令,立即把被改文件恢复到 HEAD,再限时(3 秒)等子命令退出,超时补 SIGKILL,最后以 130 退出。
- 为什么改:原来用同步 `spawnSync`,子命令活着时事件循环被占住,信号处理器跑不了:被 10 分钟前台上限掐断时文件停在被改状态、子进程成孤儿留在锁队列;子命令自然结束时信号还会被吞掉,退出码读成 0。
- 风险与回滚:仅内部脚本,不发布,不是任何必经路径;正常退出语义(子命令退出码透传、正常恢复、命令不存在或被信号杀死记 1)逐字不变且新钉了两条;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` 的信号处理器(转发、恢复、限时等待三步的顺序)→ WRAP 段 `spawn` 与 `childDone` → 新自测电池 `WRAP mode answers a signal while the child is alive`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --self-test`,预期末行 `ok ablation-replace self-test: all 63 cases pass, in both directions.`,耗时约 4 秒。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` only.

- WRAP mode runs the wrapped command with an async `spawn` instead of `spawnSync`. Node delivers `process.on('SIGTERM')` through the event loop, and `spawnSync` holds that loop for the child's whole life, so the restore the header promised could not run while the child waited.
- A signal while the child lives now does three things, in this order: forward the same signal to the child; restore at once, synchronously (the signal may be the only warning before an untrappable SIGKILL); await the child, sending SIGKILL after `WRAP_KILL_GRACE_MS` (3000, exported), then exit 130. A second signal during that wait is forwarded and nothing else.
- The child stays in the tool's process group (no `detached`), so a kill aimed at the whole group, SIGKILL included, still takes the child with it.
- Normal-exit semantics are unchanged: the child's status passes through, the restore runs and is proven, `EXIT.RESTORE` (4) on an unproven restore, and a child that never spawned or died by a signal reads 1, as `spawnSync`'s null status did.
- The header gains a section, "A handler only runs on a free event loop: WRAP spawns ASYNC", with the measured failure.
- Self-test: a new battery `WRAP mode answers a signal while the child is alive` (11 cases), plus 3 control cases in the WRAP battery (unspawnable command exits 1 and restores; a signal-killed child exits 1 and names the signal). The total goes from 49 to 63 cases, and the battery floor goes from 6 to 7.

The new battery sends the SIGTERM mid-wait. The self-test is synchronous, so a small driver spawns the tool asynchronously and waits for the child to report its pid and whether it saw the mutation. It then signals the tool's own pid (not the group) and reports JSON. There are two children: a cooperative one, and one that ignores SIGTERM to exercise the SIGKILL escalation.

## Tests

- Red first, on `origin/main` (`ba321c27`): SIGTERM to the tool's pid while WRAP waits on `sleep 30`, then the harness's escalation simulated with SIGKILL 3 s later. The output is below.
- Green: the same probe on this branch, with the output below.
- Control, the same three commands before and after: `no-such-command` exits 1 and restores; `sh -c 'kill -KILL $$'` exits 1, prints `(signal SIGKILL)` and restores; `sh -c 'exit 7'` exits 7 and restores. The output is identical before and after.
- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --self-test` at `c8fe8b4d`: `ok ablation-replace self-test: all 63 cases pass, in both directions.` (exit 0, about 4 s).
- Ablation, run once and run through the tool itself: `spawnSync` was put back in place of the async spawn, wrapping the tool's own `--self-test`. The mutation landed with anchor x1 -> x0 and blob `9051473ee0ce` -> `154f2aa5c705`. 10 of the 11 new cases went red; the 11th, "the child saw the mutation", is the precondition pin and stays green by design. Every older battery stayed green. The restore was proven: blob == HEAD `9051473ee0ce`, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker count 0.

A second probe without the SIGKILL: the tool ignored the SIGTERM until `sleep 8` ended 6.5 s later, then exited **0**, printing no signal line. The pending signal was dropped by the `process.exit` that followed `spawnSync`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Exit code after a signal stays 130 for SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP.** This is the tool's existing convention (it was already 130 for all three), not 128 + signo. It is unchanged here.
- **The restore runs before the child has exited.** A child still shutting down may read the restored file. This is deliberate: the restore must win the race against an untrappable SIGKILL, and the child's reading of an interrupted run is void anyway.
- **Boundary, NOT MEASURED: grandchildren.** The forward and the SIGKILL go to the child's pid, not to a group. If the child is a bash script waiting on a foreground grandchild, bash defers its own TERM trap until that grandchild finishes, so the grandchild can outlive the SIGKILL of bash. This was not measured against `os-verify-lock.sh`. That wrapper's header says a killed waiter leaves at most one stale queue entry, which it reaps. Putting the child in its own group (`detached`) would cover grandchildren, but a kill aimed at the tool's group would then miss the child. The default was kept.
- **The self-test is about 3.5 s longer.** The ignoring-child case waits out the 3 s grace.
- **Observation, kept unchanged:** a wrapped command that cannot be spawned prints only `command exited 1`, with no spawn error. This is pre-existing and kept byte-identical, as the card asked. It was not filed.
- **No changeset.** `scripts/**` is not published. The `skip-changeset` label is declared with this create.

## Verification

- Gate list derived on the final tree `c8fe8b4d` (after one merge of `origin/main`, `5fb79bc0`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, which gives 28 commands. Passing the path explicitly gives the identical list.
- All 28 commands exited 0, each exit code captured before any pipe (after `pnpm install`; the first pass without `node_modules` gave exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, on 6 gates and was discarded).
- `--ran` reconciliation: `28 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 28 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- CI-owned families (the type-check lanes, the artifact rosters, the always-runs tail and `test:repo`) are left to this PR's check-runs.
